_comment: Bean sfhr. The three defects the bean names (70c7 empty body, 52dz folded title, nvbr blocked on a scrapped bean) plus the five the same readers found beside them, as they stood on 2026-09-20. sfhr is explicit that these are repaired BY THEIR OWNERS and that the bean does not edit them, so the check lists them and fails only on a NEW one. Remove an entry when its bean is repaired; check-bean-bodies reports an entry that no longer matches as stale, so the baseline shrinks rather than fossilises.
